sections.h2: What the MVNO billing platform includes

blocks.text: BSS in a Box packages Digital BSS for a new MVNO launch: self-care, CRM, billing, charging and mobile POS in one defined offer. Each brand runs on its own deployment.
A new MVNO needs billing, charging, self-care and a CRM from day one. A custom BSS project is slow to scope for a brand that has not launched yet, and a platform with a fixed scope removes that wait.

head: Fact
Detail
rows: The host operator's network or an MVNE. Payment gateways.
In your environment, on Kubernetes, with 24x7 support

blocks.text: Also known as: **MVNO BSS**, MVNO in a box, launch package
Self-care, CRM, billing, charging and mobile POS come in one package. A new brand has what it needs from day one.
It connects to the host operator's network or to an MVNE, and to payment gateways.
The scope is defined in advance. There is no custom BSS project to specify before the brand exists.
Prepaid, postpaid and hybrid plans are covered.

sections.h2: Each brand's data and outages stay separate

blocks.text: Each of your brands runs on its own deployment. Data, upgrades and outages stay separate.
An operator replacing a BSS it already runs is a Digital BSS project.

items.q: What is an MVNO billing platform?
items.a: An **MVNO billing platform** rates usage, charges balances and bills subscribers for a mobile virtual network operator, which buys network capacity from a host operator.

items.q: What does BSS in a Box include?
items.a: Self-care, CRM, billing, real-time charging and mobile POS, in one defined package.

items.q: Can it connect through an MVNE?
items.a: Yes. It connects to the host operator's network directly or through an MVNE.
Read the guide: How to launch an MVNO →

blocks.text: Your team installs BSS in a Box in containers, one standard way, from the same automated guide as every Alepo product. Upgrades stay small.

When something needs fixing, the patch goes only to the component affected, with rollback ready, so your maintenance window stays short and nothing else has to be upgraded at the same time. BSS in a Box runs on Kubernetes in your environment, operated by your team or by Alepo, with 24x7 support from GTAC.
The build you test and see demoed is the build that goes live.
